steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

We often get several tickets about the same issue. Let staff merge a duplicate into another
ticket belonging to the same customer:

```http
POST /api/v1/tickets/42/merge

{"merge":{"target_id":57}}
```

Return `source` and `target`. Close ticket 42, leave it readable, and add `merged_into_id:57` so
both staff and the customer can follow the conversation. Include a null pointer on unmerged
records and let both views filter for closed tickets. The closed ticket should reject further
edits and incoming email replies. Don't move its old comments or change the surviving ticket's
status, assignment, or email identity.

Leave a note on each side explaining the merge. Default to private notes; staff can supply their
own text and choose to make either note public:

```json
{"merge":{"target_id":57,"source_comment":{"body":"Continuing in ticket 57.","public":true},"target_comment":{"body":"Duplicate checked.","public":false}}}
```

Merge notes shouldn't send email. Assignment cleanup still applies to closed tickets.
If the surviving ticket is later merged again, keep the original links rather than rewriting history.

    class BaseController < ApplicationController

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |e|

      before_action :require_account!

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render_error("X-Helpdesk-Account header is required", status: :bad_request)
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        unless @current_account
          render_error("Account not found", status: :not_found)
        end
      end

      def require_authentication!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        unless @current_session
          return render_error("Authentication required", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render_error("Account is cancelled", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_user&.owner?
          render_error("Only the account owner can perform this action", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_admin!
        unless current_user&.admin?
          render_error("Admin access required", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user&.staff?
          render_error("Staff access required", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_hash_param(key, source = params)
        value = source.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end

        value
      end

      def optional_hash_param(key, source = params)
        return nil unless source.key?(key)

        value = source[key]
        return nil if value.nil?

        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end

        value
      end

      def parse_id_param(key = :id)
        raw = params[key]
        value = Integer(raw.to_s, 10)
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless value.positive?

        value
      rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        scheme, token = header.split(/\s+/, 2)
        return nil unless scheme&.casecmp?("Bearer") && token.present?

        token.strip
      end

      def render_error(message, status:, errors: nil)
        payload = { error: message }
        payload[:errors] = errors if errors.present?
        render json: payload, status: status
      end

      def render_model_errors(record)
        errors_hash = record.errors.to_hash(true)
        message = record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end

      def render_validation_errors(errors_hash)
        message = errors_hash.values.flatten.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end
    end

module InboundEmailMessageId
  module_function

  def extract(mail, fallback: nil)
    raw = extract_raw(mail) || fallback
    normalize(raw)
  end

  def normalize(value)
    return nil if value.nil?

    cleaned = value.to_s.dup
    unless cleaned.encoding == Encoding::UTF_8 && cleaned.valid_encoding?
      cleaned = cleaned.encode(Encoding::UTF_8, invalid: :replace, undef: :replace)
    end
    cleaned = cleaned.delete("\x00").strip
    cleaned = cleaned.sub(/\A<+/, "").sub(/>+\z/, "").strip
    cleaned.presence
  rescue StandardError
    nil
  end

  def extract_raw(mail)
    return nil unless mail

    mail.message_id.presence || raw_header_value(mail)
  rescue StandardError
    raw_header_value(mail)
  end

  def raw_header_value(mail)
    field = Array(mail[:message_id]).last
    field&.value.to_s.strip.presence
  rescue StandardError
    nil
  end
end

    origin = "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}"

class InboundEmailRecipientResolver
  Entry = Struct.new(:address, :subdomain, :token, :reply?, keyword_init: true)
  Result = Struct.new(:status, :account, :ticket, keyword_init: true) do
    def valid?
      status == :new_ticket || status == :reply
    end

    def new_ticket?
      status == :new_ticket
    end

    def reply?
      status == :reply
    end
  end

  STRUCTURED_HEADERS = %i[to cc bcc].freeze
  EXTRA_RECIPIENT_HEADERS = %w[x-original-to x-forwarded-to delivered-to].freeze

  def initialize(mail:)
    @mail = mail
  end

  def call
    support_domain = HelpdeskConfig.support_domain
    entries = extract_support_entries(support_domain)
    return invalid if entries.empty?

    subdomains = entries.map(&:subdomain).uniq
    return invalid unless subdomains.size == 1

    subdomain = subdomains.first
    return invalid unless Account::SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT.match?(subdomain)

    account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
    return invalid if account.nil? || account.cancelled?

    reply_entries = entries.select(&:reply?)
    if reply_entries.any?
      tokens = reply_entries.map(&:token).uniq
      return invalid unless tokens.size == 1

      token = tokens.first
      return invalid if token.blank?

      ticket = account.tickets.find_by(reply_token: token)
      return invalid if ticket.nil?

      Result.new(status: :reply, account: account, ticket: ticket)
    else
      Result.new(status: :new_ticket, account: account, ticket: nil)
    end
  end

  private

  def invalid
    Result.new(status: :invalid)
  end

  def extract_support_entries(support_domain)
    addresses = collect_recipient_addresses
    addresses.uniq.filter_map do |address|
      local, domain = address.split("@", 2)
      next unless local.present? && domain == support_domain

      has_plus = local.include?("+")
      subdomain, token = local.split("+", 2)
      Entry.new(
        address: address,
        subdomain: subdomain.to_s,
        token: has_plus ? token.to_s : nil,
        reply?: has_plus
      )
    end
  end

  def collect_recipient_addresses
    addresses = []

    STRUCTURED_HEADERS.each do |header_name|
      addresses.concat(extract_structured_header_addresses(header_name))
    end

    EXTRA_RECIPIENT_HEADERS.each do |header_name|
      Array(@mail.header[header_name]).each do |field|
        addresses.concat(parse_address_list_string(field.value.to_s))
      end
    end

    addresses.filter_map do |addr|
      cleaned = addr.to_s.strip.downcase
      cleaned if cleaned.include?("@") && !cleaned.include?("\x00")
    end
  rescue StandardError
    []
  end

  def extract_structured_header_addresses(header_name)
    fields = Array(@mail[header_name])
    return [] if fields.empty?

    results = []
    fields.each do |field|
      if field.respond_to?(:element) && field.element.respond_to?(:addresses)
        results.concat(field.element.addresses.filter_map(&:address))
      else
        results.concat(parse_address_list_string(field.value.to_s))
      end
    rescue StandardError
      results.concat(parse_address_list_string(field.value.to_s))
    end
    results
  end

  def parse_address_list_string(raw)
    return [] if raw.blank?

    Mail::AddressList.new(raw).addresses.filter_map(&:address)
  rescue Mail::Field::ParseError, StandardError
    raw.scan(/[A-Z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/i)
  end
end

          render json: {
            account: serialize_account(result.account),
            user: serialize_user(result.user)
          }, status: :created
        else
          render_validation_errors(result.errors)
        end
      end

      def show
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account) }, status: :ok
      end

      def cancel
        current_account.cancel!
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account.reload) }, status: :ok
      end

      def reactivate
        unless current_account.cancelled?
          return render_error("Account is not cancelled", status: :unprocessable_content)
        end

        if current_account.reactivation_expired?
          return render_error("Account cancellation period has expired", status: :forbidden)
        end

        current_account.reactivate!
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account.reload) }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end

}

{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output": "class GroupMembershipCreation
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :group_membership, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(account:, group_id:, user_id:, default_provided: false, default: nil)
    @account = account
    @group_id = group_id
    @user_id = user_id
    @default_provided = default_provided
    @default = default
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    membership = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @account.lock!
      now = Time.current

      group = resolve_group(errors)
      user = resolve_user(errors)

      if @default_provided && @default != true && @default != false
        (errors["default"] ||= []) << "Default must be true or false"
      end

      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      user.lock!

      if @account.group_memberships.exists?(group_id: group.id, user_id: user.id)
        errors["user_id"] = [ "User is already a member of this group" ]
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      has_existing_memberships = user.group_memberships.exists?
      make_default = !has_existing_memberships || (@default_provided && @default == true)

      if make_default && has_existing_memberships
        user.group_memberships.where(default: true).update_all(default: false, updated_at: now)
      end

      membership = GroupMembership.new(
        account: @account,
        group: group,
        user: user,
        default: make_default
      )

      unless membership.valid?
        membership.errors.each do |error|
          (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
        end
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      membership.save!
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, group_membership: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded = @account.group_memberships.includes(:group, :user).find(membership.id)
      Result.new(success?: true, group_membership: reloaded, errors: {})
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    Result.new(
      success?: false,
      group_membership: nil,
      errors: { "user_id" => [ "User is already a member of this group" ] }
    )
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(success?: false, group_membership: nil, errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true))
  end

  private

  def resolve_group(errors)
    parsed_id = parse_positive_bigint(@group_id)
    if parsed_id.nil?
      (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
      return nil
    end

    group = @account.groups.find_by(id: parsed_id)
    unless group
      (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
      return nil
    end

    group
  end

  def resolve_user(errors)
    parsed_id = parse_positive_bigint(@user_id)
    if parsed_id.nil?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member in this account"
      return nil
    end

    user = @account.users.find_by(id: parsed_id)
    if user.nil?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member in this account"
      return nil
    elsif !user.staff?
      (errors["user_id"] ||= []) << "User must be a staff member"
      return nil
    end

    user
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end
end
"
}

**Merge Ticket Validation and Concurrency Deep Dive**

Okay, so I'm looking at how `GroupMembershipCreation` and `TicketUpdater` handle validation, and I'm seeing a consistent pattern. When a crucial ID (like a `group_id`, `assignee_id`, etc.) is missing, invalid, or belongs to the wrong account, it's a 422 error (`unprocessable_content`). The error message is generic, so we don't leak information about the existence of cross-account IDs! Makes sense, security first.

Now, let's nail down the merge ticket validation. There's a set of conditions we need to check:

1.  **Invalid or Non-Existent Target:** `target_id` isn't found in the current account's tickets? 422 error with the message "Target ticket must be a valid ticket in this account."
2.  **Self-Merge:** Trying to merge a ticket into itself? Also a 422, with "Cannot merge a ticket into itself".
3.  **Source Already Closed/Merged:** If the source ticket is already closed or part of a merge, it's a 422 with the message "Closed tickets cannot be merged." This also holds true if the source ticket is already merged. We cannot re-merge an already closed ticket!
4.  **Target Closed/Merged:** You can't merge *into* a closed or already-merged ticket. That's a 422 and an error message like "Cannot merge into a closed ticket". The target MUST be an active ticket.
5.  **Different Customer:** Both tickets have to belong to the same customer. Critical to check that `source.requester_id == target.requester_id`! If a staff member created a ticket via the `/requests` endpoint, we still cleanly check that both tickets belong to the same requester.
6.  **Comment Validation:** There's also comment validation! We must check these details:
    *   **Source Comment:**
        *   If a body is provided, it must be a string and not blank (`body.present?`).
        *   If a `public` is provided, it must be either strictly `true` or strictly `false`.
    *   **Target Comment:**
        *   If a body is provided, it must be a string and not blank (`body.present?`).
        *   If a `public` is provided, it must be either strictly `true` or strictly `false`.
    *   **Atomicity:** If ANY validation fails (like an invalid `target_comment.public` or a blank `source_comment.body` or closed target or wrong requester), the ENTIRE merge rolls back! No changes are made.

---

Now, let's talk about **Concurrency and Deadlock Prevention**! This is where things get interesting. What happens when two staff members try to merge tickets concurrently, or even when one merges while another updates the same ticket? We have to ensure we never run into deadlocks. We need to prevent:

*   **Deadlocks:** Where one request locks Ticket A, then tries to lock Ticket B, while another request locks Ticket B, then tries to lock Ticket A.
*   **Race Conditions:** Where two requests might get the state of a ticket at the same time and create conflicting states (like Ticket A pointing to Ticket B, and Ticket B pointing to Ticket A, a 2-cycle).

The solution? **Lock both tickets, in ascending ID order (`[source_id, target_id].uniq.sort`), inside a transaction!** This guarantees:

1.  No deadlock when two requests try to merge in opposite directions.
2.  If the source closes before the second request obtains the lock, the second request reads the committed state and cleanly rejects.
3.  Strictly serialized row locks prevent any overlap with concurrent updates or inbound email replies.

---

Finally, the **Default Merge Notes**! Let's get these details nailed down:

1.  **Author:** The staff member doing the merge.
2.  **Account:** The `source.account`.
3.  **Email Suppression:** No emails should be sent for these merge notes.
4.  **Default Public Value:** Both source and target comments default to `public: false` (private).
    *   Staff can set `source_comment.public` and `target_comment.public` independently.
5.  **Default Body Text:**

    *   On the **source** ticket, the default body is `"Closed and merged into ticket ##{target.id}."`
    *   On the **target** ticket, the default body is `"Ticket ##{source.id} was merged into this ticket."`

require "securerandom"

class Ticket < ApplicationRecord
  STATUSES = %w[open pending solved closed].freeze
  STAFF_EDITABLE_STATUSES = %w[open pending solved].freeze
  PRIORITIES = %w[normal high].freeze
  ORIGINS = %w[portal email].freeze

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :requester, class_name: "User", inverse_of: :requested_tickets
  belongs_to :group, optional: true, inverse_of: :tickets
  belongs_to :assignee, class_name: "User", optional: true, inverse_of: :assigned_tickets
  belongs_to :merged_into, class_name: "Ticket", optional: true, inverse_of: :merged_tickets
  has_many :merged_tickets, class_name: "Ticket", foreign_key: :merged_into_id, dependent: :nullify, inverse_of: :merged_into
  has_many :comments, class_name: "TicketComment", dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :ticket

  normalizes :subject, with: ->(subject) { subject.to_s.strip }

  before_validation :ensure_reply_token, on: :create

  validates :subject, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :status, presence: true, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }
  validates :priority, presence: true, inclusion: { in: PRIORITIES }
  validates :origin, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ORIGINS }
  validates :reply_token, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validate :requester_belongs_to_account
  validate :group_belongs_to_account, if: -> { group_id.present? || group.present? }
  validate :assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account, if: -> { assignee_id.present? && (new_record? || will_save_change_to_assignee_id?) }
  validate :assignee_must_belong_to_group, if: -> { group_id.present? && assignee_id.present? }
  validate :merged_into_integrity, if: -> { merged_into_id.present? || merged_into.present? }

  before_create :set_initial_public_updated_at
  before_update :update_public_updated_at_if_customer_visible

  scope :recently_active, -> { order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :public_recently_active, -> { order(public_updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :for_requester, ->(user) { where(requester_id: user.id) }
  scope :with_status, ->(status) { where(status: status) }
  scope :with_priority, ->(priority) { where(priority: priority) }
  scope :ungrouped, -> { where(group_id: nil) }
  scope :in_group, ->(group_id) { where(group_id: group_id) }
  scope :unassigned, -> { where(assignee_id: nil) }
  scope :assigned_to, ->(user_id) { where(assignee_id: user_id) }
  scope :requested_by, ->(user_id) { where(requester_id: user_id) }
  scope :search_text, ->(query) {
    return none if !query.is_a?(String) || query.include?("\x00") || !query.valid_encoding?

    pattern = "%#{sanitize_sql_like(query)}%"
    where(
      <<~SQL.squish,
        tickets.subject ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\'
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM ticket_comments
          WHERE ticket_comments.ticket_id = tickets.id
            AND ticket_comments.account_id = tickets.account_id
            AND ticket_comments.public = TRUE
            AND ticket_comments.body ILIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\'
        )
      SQL
      pattern: pattern
    )
  }

  def open?
    status == "open"
  end

  def pending?
    status == "pending"
  end

  def solved?
    status == "solved"
  end

  def closed?
    status == "closed"
  end

  def merged?
    merged_into_id.present?
  end

  def normal_priority?
    priority == "normal"
  end

  def high_priority?
    priority == "high"
  end

  def email_origin?
    origin == "email"
  end

  def reply_address
    HelpdeskConfig.ticket_reply_address(self)
  end

  private

  def ensure_reply_token
    self.reply_token ||= SecureRandom.hex(16)
  end

  def set_initial_public_updated_at
    now = updated_at || created_at || Time.current
    self.created_at ||= now
    self.updated_at ||= now
    self.public_updated_at ||= now
  end

  def update_public_updated_at_if_customer_visible
    if will_save_change_to_status? || will_save_change_to_subject? || will_save_change_to_merged_into_id?
      now = Time.current
      self.updated_at = now
      self.public_updated_at = now
    end
  end

  def requester_belongs_to_account
    return unless account_id.present? && requester.present?
    return if requester.account_id == account_id

    errors.add(:requester, "must belong to the same account")
  end

  def group_belongs_to_account
    return unless account_id.present?

    if group.nil? || group.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:group_id, "must belong to the same account")
    end
  end

  def assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account
    return unless account_id.present?

    if assignee.nil?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be an active staff member in this account")
    elsif assignee.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must belong to the same account")
    elsif !assignee.staff?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be a staff member")
    elsif assignee.suspended?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be an active staff member")
    end
  end

  def assignee_must_belong_to_group
    return unless account_id.present? && group.present? && assignee.present?
    return unless group.account_id == account_id && assignee.account_id == account_id
    return if GroupMembership.exists?(account_id: account_id, group_id: group_id, user_id: assignee_id)

    errors.add(:assignee_id, "must belong to the ticket's group")
  end

  def merged_into_integrity
    if merged_into.nil?
      errors.add(:merged_into_id, "must be a valid ticket in this account")
      return
    end

    if (id.present? && merged_into.id == id) || merged_into.equal?(self)
      errors.add(:merged_into_id, "cannot reference the ticket itself")
    end

    if account_id.present? && merged_into.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:merged_into_id, "must belong to the same account")
    end

    if requester_id.present? && merged_into.requester_id != requester_id
      errors.add(:merged_into_id, "must belong to the same customer")
    end

    if (new_record? || will_save_change_to_merged_into_id?) && merged_into.closed?
      errors.add(:merged_into_id, "cannot reference a closed ticket")
    end

    unless closed?
      errors.add(:status, "must be closed when merged into another ticket")
    end
  end
end

class TicketUpdater
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :ticket, :comment, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(
    ticket:,
    actor:,
    mode:,
    comment_provided: false,
    comment_body: nil,
    comment_public: true,
    status_provided: false,
    status: nil,
    priority_provided: false,
    priority: nil,
    group_id_provided: false,
    group_id: nil,
    assignee_id_provided: false,
    assignee_id: nil,
    solved_provided: false,
    solved: nil
  )
    @ticket = ticket
    @actor = actor
    @mode = mode
    @comment_provided = comment_provided
    @comment_body = comment_body
    @comment_public = comment_public
    @status_provided = status_provided
    @status = status
    @priority_provided = priority_provided
    @priority = priority
    @group_id_provided = group_id_provided
    @group_id = group_id
    @assignee_id_provided = assignee_id_provided
    @assignee_id = assignee_id
    @solved_provided = solved_provided
    @solved = solved
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    saved_comment = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      @ticket.lock!
      @pending_comment = nil

      errors = validate_and_apply_changes
      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      @ticket.save! if @ticket.changed?
      if @pending_comment
        @pending_comment.save!
        saved_comment = @pending_comment
      end
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, ticket: @ticket, comment: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded_ticket = @ticket.reload
      reloaded_comment = saved_comment&.reload

      if @mode == :staff && reloaded_comment&.public? && reloaded_ticket.email_origin?
        TicketMailer.staff_reply(ticket: reloaded_ticket, comment: reloaded_comment).deliver_now
      end

      Result.new(success?: true, ticket: reloaded_ticket, comment: reloaded_comment, errors: {})
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(success?: false, ticket: @ticket, comment: nil, errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true))
  end

  private

  def validate_and_apply_changes
    case @mode
    when :staff
      validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    when :customer
      validate_and_apply_customer_changes
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown update mode: #{@mode.inspect}"
    end
  end

  def validate_and_apply_staff_changes
    errors = {}

    if @ticket.closed?
      return { "base" => [ "Closed tickets cannot be updated" ] }
    end

    unless @comment_provided || @status_provided || @priority_provided || @group_id_provided || @assignee_id_provided
      return { base: [ "Provide a comment, status, priority, group_id, or assignee_id to update" ] }
    end

    if @status_provided
      if Ticket::STAFF_EDITABLE_STATUSES.include?(@status)
        @ticket.status = @status
      else
        (errors["status"] ||= []) << "Status must be one of: #{Ticket::STAFF_EDITABLE_STATUSES.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    @ticket.priority = @priority if @priority_provided

    resolved_group = nil
    group_lookup_failed = false
    if @group_id_provided && !@group_id.nil?
      parsed_group_id = parse_positive_bigint(@group_id)
      if parsed_group_id.nil?
        (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
        group_lookup_failed = true
      else
        resolved_group = @ticket.account.groups.find_by(id: parsed_group_id)
        if resolved_group.nil?
          (errors["group_id"] ||= []) << "Group must be a valid group in this account"
          group_lookup_failed = true
        end
      end
    end

    resolved_assignee = nil
    assignee_lookup_failed = false
    if @assignee_id_provided && !@assignee_id.nil?
      parsed_assignee_id = parse_positive_bigint(@assignee_id)
      if parsed_assignee_id.nil?
        (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must be an active staff member in this account"
        assignee_lookup_failed = true
      else
        resolved_assignee = @ticket.account.users.staff.active.find_by(id: parsed_assignee_id)
        if resolved_assignee.nil?
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must be an active staff member in this account"
          assignee_lookup_failed = true
        end
      end
    end

    unless group_lookup_failed || assignee_lookup_failed
      apply_group_and_assignee_changes(
        resolved_group: resolved_group,
        resolved_assignee: resolved_assignee,
        errors: errors
      )
    end

    if @comment_provided
      @pending_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @ticket.account,
        ticket: @ticket,
        author: @actor,
        body: @comment_body,
        public: @comment_public
      )
    end

    collect_errors(errors)
  end

  def apply_group_and_assignee_changes(resolved_group:, resolved_assignee:, errors:)
    if @group_id_provided
      if @group_id.nil?
        if @assignee_id_provided && !@assignee_id.nil?
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot assign a user when clearing the ticket group"
          return
        end

        @ticket.group = nil
        @ticket.group_id = nil
        @ticket.assignee = nil
        @ticket.assignee_id = nil
      else
        @ticket.group = resolved_group

        if @assignee_id_provided
          if @assignee_id.nil?
            @ticket.assignee = nil
            @ticket.assignee_id = nil
          elsif member_of_group?(resolved_assignee.id, resolved_group.id)
            @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
          else
            (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must belong to the ticket's group"
          end
        elsif @ticket.assignee_id.present? && !member_of_group?(@ticket.assignee_id, resolved_group.id)
          @ticket.assignee = nil
          @ticket.assignee_id = nil
        end
      end
    elsif @assignee_id_provided
      if @assignee_id.nil?
        @ticket.assignee = nil
        @ticket.assignee_id = nil
      elsif @ticket.group_id.present?
        if member_of_group?(resolved_assignee.id, @ticket.group_id)
          @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
        else
          (errors["assignee_id"] ||= []) << "Assignee must belong to the ticket's group"
        end
      else
        default_group = resolved_assignee.default_group
        @ticket.group = default_group if default_group.present?
        @ticket.assignee = resolved_assignee
      end
    end
  end

  def member_of_group?(user_id, group_id)
    GroupMembership.exists?(
      account_id: @ticket.account_id,
      group_id: group_id,
      user_id: user_id
    )
  end

  def validate_and_apply_customer_changes
    errors = {}

    if @ticket.closed?
      return { "base" => [ "Closed tickets cannot be updated" ] }
    end

    if @solved_provided && @solved != true && @solved != false
      (errors["solved"] ||= []) << "Solved must be true or false"
    end

    mark_solved_via_flag = @solved_provided && @solved == true

    unless @comment_provided || @status_provided || mark_solved_via_flag
      return errors.any? ? errors : { base: [ "Provide a comment or mark the request as solved" ] }
    end

    if @status_provided
      if @status == "solved"
        @ticket.status = "solved"
      else
        (errors["status"] ||= []) << "Customers can only mark a request as solved"
      end
    elsif mark_solved_via_flag
      @ticket.status = "solved"
    elsif @comment_provided && (@ticket.pending? || @ticket.solved?)
      @ticket.status = "open"
    end

    if @comment_provided
      @pending_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @ticket.account,
        ticket: @ticket,
        author: @actor,
        body: @comment_body,
        public: true
      )
    end

    collect_errors(errors)
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end

  def collect_errors(errors = {})
    unless @ticket.valid?
      @ticket.errors.each do |error|
        next if error.attribute == :status && errors["status"].present?
        next if error.attribute == :group_id && errors["group_id"].present?
        next if error.attribute == :assignee_id && errors["assignee_id"].present?

        (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
      end
    end

    if @pending_comment && !@pending_comment.valid?
      @pending_comment.errors.each do |error|
        (errors["comment.#{error.attribute}"] ||= []) << error.full_message
      end
    end

    errors
  end
end
EOF

require "securerandom"

class InboundEmailProcessor
  Result = Struct.new(:status, :ticket, :comment, keyword_init: true) do
    def accepted?
      status == :accepted
    end

    def duplicate?
      status == :duplicate
    end

    def rejected?
      status == :rejected
    end
  end

  def initialize(inbound_email:)
    @inbound_email = inbound_email
  end

  def call
    mail = parse_mail
    return rejected unless mail

    extractor = InboundEmailContentExtractor.new(mail: mail)
    sender = extractor.sender

    return rejected if InboundEmailFilter.new(mail: mail, from_email: sender&.email).ignore?

    resolution = InboundEmailRecipientResolver.new(mail: mail).call
    return rejected unless resolution.valid?
    return rejected unless sender

    if resolution.reply?
      requester = resolution.ticket.requester
      return rejected if requester.nil? || requester.suspended? || requester.email != sender.email
    end

    body = extractor.plain_text_body
    return rejected if body.blank?

    message_id = InboundEmailMessageId.extract(mail, fallback: @inbound_email.message_id)
    return rejected if message_id.blank?

    return duplicate if TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id)

    if resolution.reply?
      return rejected if resolution.ticket.closed?

      append_reply(
        account: resolution.account,
        ticket: resolution.ticket,
        sender: sender,
        body: body,
        message_id: message_id
      )
    else
      create_new_ticket(
        account: resolution.account,
        sender: sender,
        subject: extractor.subject,
        body: body,
        message_id: message_id
      )
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_mail
    @inbound_email.mail
  rescue StandardError
    nil
  end

  def rejected
    Result.new(status: :rejected)
  end

  def duplicate
    Result.new(status: :duplicate)
  end

  def create_new_ticket(account:, sender:, subject:, body:, message_id:)
    verification_token = nil
    created_user = nil
    ticket = nil
    comment = nil
    outcome = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      account.lock!
      if account.cancelled?
        outcome = :rejected
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      if TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id)
        outcome = :duplicate
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      user = account.users.find_by(email: sender.email)
      if user
        if user.suspended?
          outcome = :rejected
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end
      else
        if account.invitations.pending(Time.current).exists?(email: sender.email)
          outcome = :rejected
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        user = account.users.create!(
          name: sender.name,
          email: sender.email,
          password: SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32),
          role: "customer",
          verified_at: nil
        )
        _token_record, verification_token = UserToken.issue_for(
          user: user,
          purpose: UserToken::EMAIL_VERIFICATION
        )
        created_user = user
      end

      ticket = account.tickets.create!(
        requester: user,
        subject: subject,
        status: "open",
        origin: "email"
      )
      comment = ticket.comments.create!(
        account: account,
        author: user,
        body: body,
        public: true,
        email_message_id: message_id
      )
      outcome = :accepted
    end

    if outcome == :accepted && created_user && verification_token.present?
      UserMailer.email_verification(user: created_user, token: verification_token).deliver_now
    end

    Result.new(status: outcome || :rejected, ticket: ticket, comment: comment)
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id) ? duplicate : rejected
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid
    rejected
  end

  def append_reply(account:, ticket:, sender:, body:, message_id:)
    comment = nil
    outcome = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      ticket.lock!
      account.reload
      requester = ticket.requester.reload

      if TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id)
        outcome = :duplicate
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      if account.cancelled? || ticket.closed? || requester.suspended? || requester.email != sender.email
        outcome = :rejected
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      if ticket.pending? || ticket.solved?
        ticket.update!(status: "open")
      end

      comment = ticket.comments.create!(
        account: account,
        author: requester,
        body: body,
        public: true,
        email_message_id: message_id
      )
      outcome = :accepted
    end

    Result.new(status: outcome || :rejected, ticket: ticket, comment: comment)
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    TicketComment.exists?(email_message_id: message_id) ? duplicate : rejected
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid
    rejected
  end
end
EOF

class TicketMerger
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :source, :target, :source_comment, :target_comment, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(
    account:,
    source:,
    actor:,
    target_id:,
    source_comment_body_provided: false,
    source_comment_body: nil,
    source_comment_public_provided: false,
    source_comment_public: false,
    target_comment_body_provided: false,
    target_comment_body: nil,
    target_comment_public_provided: false,
    target_comment_public: false
  )
    @account = account
    @source = source
    @actor = actor
    @target_id = target_id
    @source_comment_body_provided = source_comment_body_provided
    @source_comment_body = source_comment_body
    @source_comment_public_provided = source_comment_public_provided
    @source_comment_public = source_comment_public
    @target_comment_body_provided = target_comment_body_provided
    @target_comment_body = target_comment_body
    @target_comment_public_provided = target_comment_public_provided
    @target_comment_public = target_comment_public
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    source_id = @source.id
    target_id = nil
    saved_source_comment = nil
    saved_target_comment = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      parsed_target_id = parse_positive_bigint(@target_id)
      if parsed_target_id.nil?
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must be a valid ticket in this account"
      end

      ids_to_lock = parsed_target_id ? [ source_id, parsed_target_id ].uniq.sort : [ source_id ]
      locked_tickets = @account.tickets.where(id: ids_to_lock).order(:id).lock.index_by(&:id)

      source = locked_tickets[source_id]
      raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound if source.nil?

      target = parsed_target_id ? locked_tickets[parsed_target_id] : nil

      validate_tickets(source: source, target: target, target_id_parsed: parsed_target_id.present?, errors: errors)
      validate_comment_options(
        prefix: "source_comment",
        body_provided: @source_comment_body_provided,
        body: @source_comment_body,
        public_provided: @source_comment_public_provided,
        public_value: @source_comment_public,
        errors: errors
      )
      validate_comment_options(
        prefix: "target_comment",
        body_provided: @target_comment_body_provided,
        body: @target_comment_body,
        public_provided: @target_comment_public_provided,
        public_value: @target_comment_public,
        errors: errors
      )

      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source_body = @source_comment_body_provided ? @source_comment_body : default_source_comment_body(target)
      source_public = @source_comment_public_provided ? @source_comment_public : false
      target_body = @target_comment_body_provided ? @target_comment_body : default_target_comment_body(source)
      target_public = @target_comment_public_provided ? @target_comment_public : false

      source_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @account,
        ticket: source,
        author: @actor,
        body: source_body,
        public: source_public
      )
      target_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @account,
        ticket: target,
        author: @actor,
        body: target_body,
        public: target_public
      )

      collect_comment_errors(source_comment, prefix: "source_comment", errors: errors)
      collect_comment_errors(target_comment, prefix: "target_comment", errors: errors)
      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source_comment.save!
      target_comment.save!

      source.status = "closed"
      source.merged_into = target
      unless source.valid?
        source.errors.each do |error|
          (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
        end
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source.save!

      target_id = target.id
      saved_source_comment = source_comment
      saved_target_comment = target_comment
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, source: @source, target: nil, source_comment: nil, target_comment: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded = @account.tickets
                         .includes(:requester, :group, :assignee)
                         .where(id: [ source_id, target_id ])
                         .index_by(&:id)
      Result.new(
        success?: true,
        source: reloaded.fetch(source_id),
        target: reloaded.fetch(target_id),
        source_comment: saved_source_comment.reload,
        target_comment: saved_target_comment.reload,
        errors: {}
      )
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(
      success?: false,
      source: @source,
      target: nil,
      source_comment: nil,
      target_comment: nil,
      errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true)
    )
  end

  private

  def validate_tickets(source:, target:, target_id_parsed:, errors:)
    if source.closed? || source.merged?
      (errors["base"] ||= []) << "Closed tickets cannot be merged"
    end

    return unless target_id_parsed

    if target.nil?
      (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must be a valid ticket in this account"
    elsif target.id == source.id
      (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot merge a ticket into itself"
    else
      if target.closed? || target.merged?
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot merge into a closed ticket"
      end

      if target.requester_id != source.requester_id
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must belong to the same customer"
      end
    end
  end

  def validate_comment_options(prefix:, body_provided:, body:, public_provided:, public_value:, errors:)
    label = prefix.tr("_", " ").capitalize

    if body_provided
      if !body.is_a?(String) || body.blank? || body.include?("\x00") || !body.valid_encoding?
        (errors["#{prefix}.body"] ||= []) << "#{label} body can't be blank"
      end
    end

    if public_provided && public_value != true && public_value != false
      (errors["#{prefix}.public"] ||= []) << "#{label} public must be true or false"
    end
  end

  def collect_comment_errors(comment, prefix:, errors:)
    return if comment.valid?

    comment.errors.each do |error|
      (errors["#{prefix}.#{error.attribute}"] ||= []) << error.full_message
    end
  end

  def default_source_comment_body(target)
    "Closed and merged into ticket ##{target.id}."
  end

  def default_target_comment_body(source)
    "Ticket ##{source.id} was merged into this ticket."
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class TicketsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_authentication!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_staff!

      def index
        base_scope = current_account.tickets.recently_active.includes(:requester, :group, :assignee)
        result = TicketFilter.new(scope: base_scope, params: params, mode: :staff).call
        return render_validation_errors(result.errors) unless result.success?

        payload = paginate_collection(result.scope, key: :tickets) { |ticket| serialize_ticket(ticket) }
        render json: payload, status: :ok
      end

      def show
        ticket = find_ticket!
        render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        ticket = find_ticket!
        ticket_envelope = require_hash_param(:ticket)
        comment_envelope = optional_hash_param(:comment, ticket_envelope)

        status_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:status)
        status_value = status_provided ? ticket_envelope.permit(:status)[:status] : nil

        priority_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:priority)
        priority_value = priority_provided ? ticket_envelope.permit(:priority)[:priority] : nil

        group_id_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:group_id)
        group_id_value = group_id_provided ? ticket_envelope[:group_id] : nil

        assignee_id_provided = ticket_envelope.key?(:assignee_id)
        assignee_id_value = assignee_id_provided ? ticket_envelope[:assignee_id] : nil

        comment_public = true
        if comment_envelope&.key?(:public)
          raw_public = comment_envelope[:public]
          comment_public = (raw_public == true || raw_public == false) ? raw_public : nil
        end

        result = TicketUpdater.new(
          ticket: ticket,
          actor: current_user,
          mode: :staff,
          comment_provided: !comment_envelope.nil?,
          comment_body: comment_envelope ? comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body] : nil,
          comment_public: comment_public,
          status_provided: status_provided,
          status: status_value,
          priority_provided: priority_provided,
          priority: priority_value,
          group_id_provided: group_id_provided,
          group_id: group_id_value,
          assignee_id_provided: assignee_id_provided,
          assignee_id: assignee_id_value
        ).call

        if result.success?
          render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(result.ticket) }, status: :ok
        else
          render_validation_errors(result.errors)
        end
      end

      def merge
        source = find_ticket!
        merge_envelope = require_hash_param(:merge)
        source_comment_envelope = optional_hash_param(:source_comment, merge_envelope)
        target_comment_envelope = optional_hash_param(:target_comment, merge_envelope)

        source_body_provided = source_comment_envelope&.key?(:body) || false
        source_body = source_body_provided ? source_comment_envelope[:body] : nil
        source_public_provided = source_comment_envelope&.key?(:public) || false
        source_public = source_public_provided ? source_comment_envelope[:public] : false

        target_body_provided = target_comment_envelope&.key?(:body) || false
        target_body = target_body_provided ? target_comment_envelope[:body] : nil
        target_public_provided = target_comment_envelope&.key?(:public) || false
        target_public = target_public_provided ? target_comment_envelope[:public] : false

        result = TicketMerger.new(
          account: current_account,
          source: source,
          actor: current_user,
          target_id: merge_envelope[:target_id],
          source_comment_body_provided: source_body_provided,
          source_comment_body: source_body,
          source_comment_public_provided: source_public_provided,
          source_comment_public: source_public,
          target_comment_body_provided: target_body_provided,
          target_comment_body: target_body,
          target_comment_public_provided: target_public_provided,
          target_comment_public: target_public
        ).call

        if result.success?
          render json: {
            source: serialize_ticket(result.source),
            target: serialize_ticket(result.target)
          }, status: :ok
        else
          render_validation_errors(result.errors)
        end
      end

      private

      def find_ticket!
        current_account.tickets.includes(:requester, :group, :assignee).find(parse_id_param(:id))
      end
    end
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class TicketMergeIntegrityTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @acme = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    @globex = Account.create!(name: "Globex", subdomain: "globex")

    @acme_admin = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Jo",
      email: "jo@acme.test",
      password: "jo-password-1",
      role: "admin",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @acme_avery = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Avery",
      email: "avery@example.test",
      password: "avery-password-1",
      role: "customer",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @acme_blake = @acme.users.create!(
      name: "Blake",
      email: "blake@example.test",
      password: "blake-password-1",
      role: "customer",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @globex_casey = @globex.users.create!(
      name: "Casey",
      email: "casey@example.test",
      password: "casey-password-1",
      role: "customer",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
  end

  test "ticket enforces merged_into integrity, closed status requirement, and preserves validity across chained merges" do
    t1 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Duplicate 1")
    t2 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Primary 2")
    t3 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Final 3")
    blake_ticket = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_blake, subject: "Other customer")
    globex_ticket = @globex.tickets.create!(requester: @globex_casey, subject: "Other account")

    assert_not t1.closed?
    assert_not t1.merged?

    # Non-closed ticket cannot have merged_into
    t1.merged_into = t2
    assert_not t1.valid?
    assert_includes t1.errors[:status], "must be closed when merged into another ticket"

    # Self-merge rejected (persisted and unsaved)
    t1.status = "closed"
    t1.merged_into = t1
    assert_not t1.valid?
    assert_includes t1.errors[:merged_into_id], "cannot reference the ticket itself"

    unsaved = @acme.tickets.new(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Unsaved self", status: "closed")
    unsaved.merged_into = unsaved
    assert_not unsaved.valid?
    assert_includes unsaved.errors[:merged_into_id], "cannot reference the ticket itself"

    # Cross-account rejected
    t1.merged_into = globex_ticket
    assert_not t1.valid?
    assert_includes t1.errors[:merged_into_id], "must belong to the same account"

    # Cross-customer rejected
    t1.merged_into = blake_ticket
    assert_not t1.valid?
    assert_includes t1.errors[:merged_into_id], "must belong to the same customer"

    # Non-existent merged_into_id rejected
    t1.merged_into = nil
    t1.merged_into_id = 999_999_999
    assert_not t1.valid?
    assert_includes t1.errors[:merged_into_id], "must be a valid ticket in this account"

    # Valid merge of t1 -> t2
    t1.merged_into = t2
    assert t1.valid?
    t1.save!
    assert t1.closed?
    assert t1.merged?
    assert_equal t2.id, t1.merged_into_id

    # Cannot merge another ticket into closed t1
    t3.status = "closed"
    t3.merged_into = t1
    assert_not t3.valid?
    assert_includes t3.errors[:merged_into_id], "cannot reference a closed ticket"
    t3.reload

    # Chained merge: t2 -> t3 leaves t1 pointing to t2 and still valid!
    t2.update!(status: "closed", merged_into: t3)
    assert_equal t2.id, t1.reload.merged_into_id
    assert t1.valid?, "Previously merged ticket must remain valid when its target is later merged"
    assert_equal t3.id, t2.reload.merged_into_id
    assert_nil t3.reload.merged_into_id
  end

  test "ticket_comment rejects new comments on closed tickets while existing comments remain valid" do
    t1 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Duplicate")
    t2 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "Target")

    late_comment = t1.comments.build(account: @acme, author: @acme_admin, body: "Too late", public: false)
    assert_not late_comment.valid?

    t2 = @acme.tickets.create!(requester: @acme_avery, subject: "T2")

    assert_not Ticket.exists?(t2.id)
    assert_not Ticket.exists?(t3.id)

  def post_raw_email(raw_email)
    headers = {
      "CONTENT_TYPE" => "message/rfc822",
      "HTTP_AUTHORIZATION" => ActionController::HttpAuthentication::Basic.encode_credentials("actionmailbox", INGRESS_PASSWORD)
    }
    post INGRESS_PATH, params: raw_email, headers: headers
  end

  def build_raw_email(from:, to:, cc: nil, subject:, body:, message_id: "<msg-#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}@mail.example.test>")
    lines = [
      "Message-ID: #{message_id}",
      "From: #{from}",
      "To: #{to}"
    ]
    lines << "Cc: #{cc}" if cc
    lines << "Subject: #{subject}"
    lines << "Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:00:00 +0000"
    lines << "MIME-Version: 1.0"
    lines << "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8"
    lines << ""
    lines << body
    lines.join("\r\n")
  end

  test "closed tickets reject all further edits from both staff and customers and cannot be merged again or targeted" do
    billing = create_group(name: "Billing")
    add_membership(group_id: billing["id"], user_id: @agent_id, default: true)

    source = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Closed dup", body: "Hello")
    target = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Active target", body: "Main")
    other = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Third ticket", body: "Another")

    # Staff still cannot manually PATCH status=closed on an open ticket
    assert_no_difference "TicketComment.count" do
      patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{source["id"]}",
            params: { ticket: { status: "closed", comment: { body: "Nope" } } },
            headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
            as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
      assert_equal "open", Ticket.find(source["id"]).status
    end

    # Merge source into target
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{source["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: target["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    closed_snapshot = Ticket.find(source["id"])

    # Staff edits on closed ticket are ALL rejected with 422
    staff_edit_payloads = [
      { status: "open" },
      { status: "pending" },
      { status: "solved" },
      { status: "closed" },
      { priority: "high" },
      { group_id: billing["id"] },
      { group_id: nil },
      { assignee_id: @agent_id },
      { assignee_id: nil },
      { comment: { body: "Public reply on closed ticket", public: true } },
      { comment: { body: "Private note on closed ticket", public: false } },
      { status: "open", comment: { body: "Reopen attempt", public: true } }
    ]

    assert_no_difference [ "TicketComment.count", "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size" ] do
      staff_edit_payloads.each do |payload|
        patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{source["id"]}",
              params: { ticket: payload },
              headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
              as: :json
        assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for staff PATCH #{payload.inspect} on closed ticket"
      end
    end

    # Customer edits on closed ticket are ALL rejected with 422
    customer_edit_payloads = [
      { comment: { body: "Customer follow-up on closed ticket" } },
      { status: "solved" },
      { solved: true },
      { solved: false },
      { status: "solved", comment: { body: "Thanks" } }
    ]

    assert_no_difference "TicketComment.count" do
      customer_edit_payloads.each do |payload|
        patch "/api/v1/requests/#{source["id"]}",
              params: { request: payload },
              headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @avery_token),
              as: :json
        assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for customer PATCH #{payload.inspect} on closed ticket"
      end
    end

    # Merging an already-closed source or merging into an already-closed target are rejected with 422
    assert_no_difference "TicketComment.count" do
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{source["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: other["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{other["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: source["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
    end

    closed_after = Ticket.find(source["id"])
    assert_equal "closed", closed_after.status
    assert_equal target["id"], closed_after.merged_into_id
    assert_equal closed_snapshot.updated_at, closed_after.updated_at
    assert_equal closed_snapshot.public_updated_at, closed_after.public_updated_at
  end

        to: "acme@support.example.test",
        subject: "Email duplicate",
        body: "First email issue",
        message_id: "<email-src-1@example.test>"
      ))
      assert_response :no_content

      post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
        from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
        to: "acme@support.example.test",
        subject: "Email primary",
        body: "Primary email issue",
        message_id: "<email-tgt-1@example.test>"
      ))
      assert_response :no_content

      email_source = @acme.tickets.find_by!(subject: "Email duplicate")
      email_target = @acme.tickets.find_by!(subject: "Email primary")
      email_target.update!(status: "pending")
      target_token_before = email_target.reply_token

      ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear

      # Merge email_source into email_target with BOTH notes PUBLIC -> ZERO emails sent!
      assert_no_difference "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size" do
        post "/api/v1/tickets/#{email_source.id}/merge",
             params: {
               merge: {
                 target_id: email_target.id,
                 source_comment: { body: "Public merge note on source", public: true },
                 target_comment: { body: "Public merge note on target", public: true }
               }
             },
             headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
             as: :json
        assert_response :ok
      end

      source_updated_before = email_source.reload.updated_at
      source_pub_updated_before = email_source.public_updated_at

      # Incoming email reply to closed email_source is REJECTED (bounced!)
      assert_no_difference [ "Ticket.count", "TicketComment.count", "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size" ] do
        post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
          from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
          to: email_source.reply_address,
          subject: "Re: Email duplicate",
          body: "Trying to reply to closed ticket",
          message_id: "<email-src-reply-after-close@example.test>"
        ))
        assert_response :no_content
      end
      assert ActionMailbox::InboundEmail.order(:id).last.bounced?
      assert_equal "closed", email_source.reload.status
      assert_equal source_updated_before, email_source.updated_at
      assert_equal source_pub_updated_before, email_source.public_updated_at

      # Reply to closed source even when CC'ing support address is ALSO rejected (does not spawn new ticket!)
      assert_no_difference [ "Ticket.count", "TicketComment.count" ] do
        post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
          from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
          to: email_source.reply_address,
          cc: "acme@support.example.test",
          subject: "Re: Email duplicate",
          body: "Still replying to closed ticket",
          message_id: "<email-src-reply-cc@example.test>"
        ))
        assert_response :no_content
      end
      assert ActionMailbox::InboundEmail.order(:id).last.bounced?

      # Redelivery of an email already imported BEFORE merge remains idempotent (not duplicated)
      assert_no_difference [ "Ticket.count", "TicketComment.count" ] do
        post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
          from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
          to: email_source.reply_address,
          subject: "Email duplicate",
          body: "First email issue",
          message_id: "<email-src-1@example.test>"
        ))
        assert_response :no_content
      end

      # Surviving email_target keeps its exact reply_token, origin, and email thread identity
      assert_equal "email", email_target.reload.origin
      assert_equal target_token_before, email_target.reply_token
      assert_equal "pending", email_target.status

      # Customer email reply to surviving email_target STILL works (appends comment and reopens from pending)
      assert_difference "TicketComment.count", 1 do
        post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
          from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
          to: email_target.reply_address,
          subject: "Re: Email primary",
          body: "Continuing on the surviving ticket!",
          message_id: "<email-tgt-2@example.test>"
        ))
        assert_response :no_content
      end
      assert ActionMailbox::InboundEmail.order(:id).last.delivered?
      assert_equal "open", email_target.reload.status

      # Subsequent staff public reply on surviving email_target sends email with target's reply_address & message IDs ONLY
      assert_difference "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size", 1 do
        patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{email_target.id}",
              params: { ticket: { comment: { body: "Here is your update.", public: true } } },
              headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
              as: :json
        assert_response :ok
      end

      mail = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
      assert_equal [ email_target.reply_address ], mail.from
      assert_equal [ email_target.reply_address ], mail.reply_to
      assert_equal "<email-tgt-2@example.test>", mail.header["In-Reply-To"].to_s
      assert_includes mail.header["References"].to_s, "<email-tgt-1@example.test>"
      assert_includes mail.header["References"].to_s, "<email-tgt-2@example.test>"
      assert_not_includes mail.header["References"].to_s, "<email-src-1@example.test>"

      # Merging an email-origin source into a portal-origin target leaves target as portal-origin (no email on merge OR later staff reply)
      post_raw_email(build_raw_email(
        from: "Avery <avery@example.test>",
        to: "acme@support.example.test",
        subject: "Another email dup",
        body: "From email",
        message_id: "<email-src-portal-tgt@example.test>"
      ))
      assert_response :no_content
      email_src2 = @acme.tickets.find_by!(subject: "Another email dup")

      portal_tgt_data = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Portal target", body: "Created in portal")
      portal_tgt = Ticket.find(portal_tgt_data["id"])
      portal_token_before = portal_tgt.reply_token

      ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
      assert_no_difference "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size" do
        post "/api/v1/tickets/#{email_src2.id}/merge",
             params: {
               merge: {
                 target_id: portal_tgt.id,
                 source_comment: { body: "Moving to portal ticket", public: true },
                 target_comment: { body: "Merged email dup", public: true }
               }
             },
             headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
             as: :json
        assert_response :ok
      end

      assert_equal "portal", portal_tgt.reload.origin
      assert_equal portal_token_before, portal_tgt.reply_token

      # Staff reply to portal target still sends NO email (email identity unchanged!)
      assert_no_difference "ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size" do
        patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{portal_tgt.id}",
              params: { ticket: { comment: { body: "Portal reply only", public: true } } },
              headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
              as: :json
        assert_response :ok
      end
    end
  end

  test "chained merges preserve original merged_into_id links without rewriting history" do
    t1 = t2 = t3 = nil

    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-11-22 10:00:00 UTC") do
      t1 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Ticket 1", body: "One")
      t2 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Ticket 2", body: "Two")
      t3 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Ticket 3", body: "Three")
    end

    # First merge: T1 -> T2
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-11-22 10:10:00 UTC") do
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{t1["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: t2["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @agent_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "closed", json_body.dig("source", "status")
      assert_equal t2["id"], json_body.dig("source", "merged_into_id")
      assert_nil json_body.dig("target", "merged_into_id")
    end

    t1_after_first_merge = Ticket.find(t1["id"])
    t1_comment_count = t1_after_first_merge.comments.count

    # Second merge: surviving T2 -> T3
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-11-22 10:20:00 UTC") do
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{t2["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: t3["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "closed", json_body.dig("source", "status")
      assert_equal t3["id"], json_body.dig("source", "merged_into_id")
      assert_equal "open", json_body.dig("target", "status")
      assert_nil json_body.dig("target", "merged_into_id")
    end

    # T1 STILL points to T2 (not rewritten to T3!), and T1's timestamps & comments are untouched
    t1_final = Ticket.find(t1["id"])
    assert_equal t2["id"], t1_final.merged_into_id
    assert_equal "closed", t1_final.status
    assert_equal t1_after_first_merge.updated_at, t1_final.updated_at
    assert_equal t1_after_first_merge.public_updated_at, t1_final.public_updated_at
    assert_equal t1_comment_count, t1_final.comments.count

    # Staff and customer both see the exact chain T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> null
    get "/api/v1/tickets/#{t1["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal t2["id"], json_body.dig("ticket", "merged_into_id")
    get "/api/v1/tickets/#{t2["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_equal t3["id"], json_body.dig("ticket", "merged_into_id")
    get "/api/v1/tickets/#{t3["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_nil json_body.dig("ticket", "merged_into_id")

    get "/api/v1/requests/#{t1["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @avery_token)
    assert_equal t2["id"], json_body.dig("request", "merged_into_id")
    get "/api/v1/requests/#{t2["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @avery_token)
    assert_equal t3["id"], json_body.dig("request", "merged_into_id")
    get "/api/v1/requests/#{t3["id"]}", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @avery_token)
    assert_nil json_body.dig("request", "merged_into_id")

    # Cannot merge T1 -> T3, T3 -> T2, or T3 -> T1
    [ [ t1["id"], t3["id"] ], [ t3["id"], t2["id"] ], [ t3["id"], t1["id"] ] ].each do |src_id, tgt_id|
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{src_id}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: tgt_id } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for merge #{src_id} -> #{tgt_id}"
    end
  end

  test "merge enforces authorization, tenant isolation, customer matching, and atomic parameter validation" do
    avery_t1 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Avery 1", body: "One")
    avery_t2 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @avery_token, subject: "Avery 2", body: "Two")
    blake_t1 = create_request(subdomain: "acme", token: @blake_token, subject: "Blake 1", body: "Other")
    globex_t1 = create_request(subdomain: "globex", token: @casey_token, subject: "Globex 1", body: "Other tenant")

    # Missing account header -> 400
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         as: :json
    assert_response :bad_request

    # Unknown account -> 404
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "nonexistent", token: @owner_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :not_found

    # Unauthenticated -> 401
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme"),
         as: :json
    assert_response :unauthorized

    # Customer forbidden -> 403
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @avery_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Cross-tenant source -> 404
    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{globex_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
         as: :json
    assert_response :not_found

    # Bad source IDs -> 404
    [ "abc", "0", "-1", "999999999999999999999999999", "999999" ].each do |bad_id|
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{bad_id}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :not_found, "Expected 404 for source id=#{bad_id}"
    end

    # Bad / missing envelopes -> 400
    [
      {},
      { merge: nil },
      { merge: {} },
      { merge: "invalid" },
      { merge: [ avery_t2["id"] ] },
      { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: "not a hash" } },
      { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: [ "bad" ] } }
    ].each do |bad_params|
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
           params: bad_params,
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :bad_request, "Expected 400 for params=#{bad_params.inspect}"
    end

    # All invalid business / field validations return 422 and roll back atomically
    assert_no_difference "TicketComment.count" do
      # Cross-account target returns same 422 message as missing target (no existence leak)
      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: globex_t1["id"] } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
      cross_account_error = json_body["error"]

      post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
           params: { merge: { target_id: 999_999 } },
           headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
           as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
      assert_equal cross_account_error, json_body["error"]

      # Invalid target_id values, self-merge, different customer
      invalid_merges = [
        { source_comment: { public: true } }, # missing target_id
        { target_id: nil },
        { target_id: "" },
        { target_id: 0 },
        { target_id: -5 },
        { target_id: "abc" },
        { target_id: " #{avery_t2["id"]} " },
        { target_id: 999_999_999_999_999_999_999_999 },
        { target_id: [ avery_t2["id"] ] },
        { target_id: true },
        { target_id: avery_t1["id"] }, # self-merge
        { target_id: blake_t1["id"] }, # different customer
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: "" } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: "   \n " } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: nil } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: 123 } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: [ "nope" ] } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { body: "bad\x00byte" } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { body: "" } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { body: "   " } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { body: nil } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { body: { nested: 1 } } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { public: "true" } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { public: 1 } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], source_comment: { public: nil } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { public: "false" } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { public: 0 } },
        { target_id: avery_t2["id"], target_comment: { public: nil } }
      ]

      invalid_merges.each do |merge_params|
        post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
             params: { merge: merge_params },
             headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token),
             as: :json
        assert_response :unprocessable_content, "Expected 422 for merge=#{merge_params.inspect}"
        assert json_body["error"].present?
        assert json_body["errors"].present?
      end
    end

    assert_equal "open", Ticket.find(avery_t1["id"]).status
    assert_nil Ticket.find(avery_t1["id"]).merged_into_id
    assert_equal "open", Ticket.find(avery_t2["id"]).status
    assert_nil Ticket.find(avery_t2["id"]).merged_into_id

    # Cancelled account -> 403
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: @owner_token)
    assert_response :ok
    # Reactivate isn't needed before testing 401/403 (cancel revokes sessions, so verify with fresh cancelled check via model)
    @acme.update_column(:cancelled_at, nil)
    owner_token_2 = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "jo-password-1").dig("session", "token")
    @acme.update_column(:cancelled_at, Time.current)

    post "/api/v1/tickets/#{avery_t1["id"]}/merge",
         params: { merge: { target_id: avery_t2["id"] } },
         headers: json_headers(account: "acme", token: owner_token_2),
         as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden
  end
end

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' >> test/models/ticket_merge_integrity_test.rb

class TicketMergeConcurrencyTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  self.use_transactional_tests = false

  setup do
    @account = Account.create!(name: "Concurrency Inc", subdomain: "conc-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}")
    @staff = @account.users.create!(
      name: "Staff",
      email: "staff@conc.test",
      password: "staff-password-1",
      role: "admin",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    @customer = @account.users.create!(
      name: "Customer",
      email: "customer@conc.test",
      password: "customer-password-1",
      role: "customer",
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
  end

  teardown do
    @account&.destroy!
  end

  test "concurrent opposite-direction merges serialize cleanly without deadlock or cycle" do
    t1 = @account.tickets.create!(requester: @customer, subject: "T1")
    t2 = @account.tickets.create!(requester: @customer, subject: "T2")

    ready = Queue.new
    go = Queue.new
    results = []
    mutex = Mutex.new

    threads = [
      [ t1, t2.id ],
      [ t2, t1.id ]
    ].map do |source, target_id|
      Thread.new do
        ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.with_connection do
          ready << true
          go.pop
          res = TicketMerger.new(account: @account, source: source, actor: @staff, target_id: target_id).call
          mutex.synchronize { results << res }
        end
      end
    end

    2.times { ready.pop }
    2.times { go << true }
    threads.each(&:join)

    assert_equal 2, results.size
    assert_equal 1, results.count(&:success?), "Expected exactly 1 merge to succeed, got: #{results.map(&:errors)}"
    assert_equal 1, results.count { |r| !r.success? }

    t1.reload
    t2.reload

    t1_merged_into_t2 = t1.closed? && t1.merged_into_id == t2.id && !t2.closed? && t2.merged_into_id.nil?
    t2_merged_into_t1 = t2.closed? && t2.merged_into_id == t1.id && !t1.closed? && t1.merged_into_id.nil?
    assert(t1_merged_into_t2 || t2_merged_into_t1, "Expected exactly one acyclic merge, got t1=(#{t1.status}, #{t1.merged_into_id}) t2=(#{t2.status}, #{t2.merged_into_id})")
    assert_equal 1, t1.comments.count
    assert_equal 1, t2.comments.count
  end

  test "concurrent merges of the same source into different targets serialize cleanly" do
    t1 = @account.tickets.create!(requester: @customer, subject: "Source")
    t2 = @account.tickets.create!(requester: @customer, subject: "Target A")
    t3 = @account.tickets.create!(requester: @customer, subject: "Target B")

    ready = Queue.new
    go = Queue.new
    results = []
    mutex = Mutex.new

    threads = [ t2.id, t3.id ].map do |target_id|
      Thread.new do
        ActiveRecord::Base.connection_pool.with_connection do
          ready << true
          go.pop
          res = TicketMerger.new(account: @account, source: t1, actor: @staff, target_id: target_id).call
          mutex.synchronize { results << res }
        end
      end
    end

    2.times { ready.pop }
    2.times { go << true }
    threads.each(&:join)

    assert_equal 1, results.count(&:success?)
    assert_equal 1, results.count { |r| !r.success? }

    t1.reload
    t2.reload
    t3.reload

    assert t1.closed?
    assert_includes [ t2.id, t3.id ], t1.merged_into_id
    assert_equal 1, t1.comments.count
    assert_equal 1, t2.comments.count + t3.comments.count
  end
end
EOF
