class TicketMerger
  MAX_BIGINT = (1 << 63) - 1
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :source, :target, :source_comment, :target_comment, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(
    account:,
    source:,
    actor:,
    target_id:,
    source_comment_body_provided: false,
    source_comment_body: nil,
    source_comment_public_provided: false,
    source_comment_public: false,
    target_comment_body_provided: false,
    target_comment_body: nil,
    target_comment_public_provided: false,
    target_comment_public: false
  )
    @account = account
    @source = source
    @actor = actor
    @target_id = target_id
    @source_comment_body_provided = source_comment_body_provided
    @source_comment_body = source_comment_body
    @source_comment_public_provided = source_comment_public_provided
    @source_comment_public = source_comment_public
    @target_comment_body_provided = target_comment_body_provided
    @target_comment_body = target_comment_body
    @target_comment_public_provided = target_comment_public_provided
    @target_comment_public = target_comment_public
  end

  def call
    errors = {}
    source_id = @source.id
    target_id = nil
    saved_source_comment = nil
    saved_target_comment = nil

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      parsed_target_id = parse_positive_bigint(@target_id)
      if parsed_target_id.nil?
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must be a valid ticket in this account"
      end

      ids_to_lock = parsed_target_id ? [ source_id, parsed_target_id ].uniq.sort : [ source_id ]
      locked_tickets = @account.tickets.where(id: ids_to_lock).order(:id).lock.index_by(&:id)

      source = locked_tickets[source_id]
      raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound if source.nil?

      target = parsed_target_id ? locked_tickets[parsed_target_id] : nil

      validate_tickets(source: source, target: target, target_id_parsed: parsed_target_id.present?, errors: errors)
      validate_comment_options(
        prefix: "source_comment",
        body_provided: @source_comment_body_provided,
        body: @source_comment_body,
        public_provided: @source_comment_public_provided,
        public_value: @source_comment_public,
        errors: errors
      )
      validate_comment_options(
        prefix: "target_comment",
        body_provided: @target_comment_body_provided,
        body: @target_comment_body,
        public_provided: @target_comment_public_provided,
        public_value: @target_comment_public,
        errors: errors
      )

      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source_body = @source_comment_body_provided ? @source_comment_body : default_source_comment_body(target)
      source_public = @source_comment_public_provided ? @source_comment_public : false
      target_body = @target_comment_body_provided ? @target_comment_body : default_target_comment_body(source)
      target_public = @target_comment_public_provided ? @target_comment_public : false

      source_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @account,
        ticket: source,
        author: @actor,
        body: source_body,
        public: source_public
      )
      target_comment = TicketComment.new(
        account: @account,
        ticket: target,
        author: @actor,
        body: target_body,
        public: target_public
      )

      collect_comment_errors(source_comment, prefix: "source_comment", errors: errors)
      collect_comment_errors(target_comment, prefix: "target_comment", errors: errors)
      if errors.any?
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source_comment.save!
      target_comment.save!

      source.status = "closed"
      source.merged_into = target
      unless source.valid?
        source.errors.each do |error|
          (errors[error.attribute.to_s] ||= []) << error.full_message
        end
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end

      source.save!

      target_id = target.id
      saved_source_comment = source_comment
      saved_target_comment = target_comment
    end

    if errors.any?
      Result.new(success?: false, source: @source, target: nil, source_comment: nil, target_comment: nil, errors: errors)
    else
      reloaded = @account.tickets
                         .includes(:requester, :group, :assignee)
                         .where(id: [ source_id, target_id ])
                         .index_by(&:id)
      Result.new(
        success?: true,
        source: reloaded.fetch(source_id),
        target: reloaded.fetch(target_id),
        source_comment: saved_source_comment.reload,
        target_comment: saved_target_comment.reload,
        errors: {}
      )
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    Result.new(
      success?: false,
      source: @source,
      target: nil,
      source_comment: nil,
      target_comment: nil,
      errors: e.record.errors.to_hash(true)
    )
  end

  private

  def validate_tickets(source:, target:, target_id_parsed:, errors:)
    if source.closed? || source.merged?
      (errors["base"] ||= []) << "Closed tickets cannot be merged"
    end

    return unless target_id_parsed

    if target.nil?
      (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must be a valid ticket in this account"
    elsif target.id == source.id
      (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot merge a ticket into itself"
    else
      if target.closed? || target.merged?
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Cannot merge into a closed ticket"
      end

      if target.requester_id != source.requester_id
        (errors["target_id"] ||= []) << "Target ticket must belong to the same customer"
      end
    end
  end

  def validate_comment_options(prefix:, body_provided:, body:, public_provided:, public_value:, errors:)
    label = prefix.tr("_", " ").capitalize

    if body_provided
      if !body.is_a?(String) || body.blank? || body.include?("\x00") || !body.valid_encoding?
        (errors["#{prefix}.body"] ||= []) << "#{label} body can't be blank"
      end
    end

    if public_provided && public_value != true && public_value != false
      (errors["#{prefix}.public"] ||= []) << "#{label} public must be true or false"
    end
  end

  def collect_comment_errors(comment, prefix:, errors:)
    return if comment.valid?

    comment.errors.each do |error|
      (errors["#{prefix}.#{error.attribute}"] ||= []) << error.full_message
    end
  end

  def default_source_comment_body(target)
    "Closed and merged into ticket ##{target.id}."
  end

  def default_target_comment_body(source)
    "Ticket ##{source.id} was merged into this ticket."
  end

  def parse_positive_bigint(raw)
    value = case raw
            when Integer
              raw
            when String
              return nil unless /\A[1-9]\d*\z/.match?(raw)
              Integer(raw, 10)
            else
              return nil
            end
    return nil unless value.positive? && value <= MAX_BIGINT

    value
  end
end
